name: תכונות של פונקציה מוגדרת בחלקים בקטע [−5,−3] – בחירת כל הנכונות (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Tick all properties that the function \(f(x)\),

\[ f(x) = \begin{cases} x, & \text{when } x \le -3;\\ -3, & \text{when } -3 \lt x \lt 4;\\ x-7, & \text{when } 4 \le x.\end{cases} \]

satisfies over the interval \([-5,-3]\).

[[input:ans]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: On the given interval only the first formula is used; we check each property for it.
Step 1 — The function on the interval
Every \(x\in[-5,-3]\) satisfies \(x\le -3\), so on this interval \(f(x)=x\).
Step 2 — Monotonicity
If \(-5\le x_1\lt x_2\le -3\) then \(f(x_1)=x_1\lt x_2=f(x_2)\): \(f\) is strictly increasing on \([-5,-3]\), and therefore also non-decreasing. It is neither non-increasing nor strictly decreasing, since \(f(-5)=-5\lt -3=f(-3)\).
Step 3 — The options
  • non-decreasing — correct: it is even strictly increasing.
  • strictly increasing — correct: step 2.
  • non-increasing — incorrect: \(f(-5)\lt f(-3)\).
  • strictly decreasing — incorrect: \(f(-5)\lt f(-3)\).
  • none of these — incorrect: two of the properties hold.

Answer: non-decreasing, strictly increasing.
